about: A reply that is only [quiet] (spaces trimmed, any case) is hidden: index.js quietReply, client.js quietText, Tether quietReply. `turns`: the steps of one completed turn (each a list of blocks: a string is a text, "tool" a tool call, "think" reasoning); `quiet` is the run rule (index.js quietRun, client.js quietTurnSet, Tether quietTexts) and `reply` the words of a turn that is news (index.js runReply, Tether newsReply). `push` is the words of Damon's Turn finished notification of that completed turn, null for none (index.js damonPushWords, Tether damonWords, 2026-11-24): a turn whose first text starts with [quiet] or whose last text ends with [quiet] gives none, not even its first part. `steered`: news turns with a prompt that came into the running turn (a string step, not a list: a message that you typed, or `@<source kind>` for a subagent's notice) and `push`, the words of Damon's notification: the part after your message answers you, so its newest text that does not start or end with [quiet] pushes; another part gives none when its first text starts with [quiet] or the turn's last text ends with [quiet]. A turn that you open by typing keeps the strict rule (test/tether-push-words.test.mjs). test/quiet-replies.test.mjs, the iOS QuietReplyTests and PushTextTests read this table.
